criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Vivid deck, navy and violet shadows, every frame a rendered world; 3 best, 8 strong, 2 a real roadside world, 5 fixed since the claw-like hand. Held down by 7 (blob root plate, dead wet asphalt with an aliased truck reflection, route barely bends), 6 (mannequin with mitten hands, pole and wire crossing the headline), 4 (straight untapered limb, a chrome sphere still on the roof), 9 (detail spread evenly, small tower, short tube at one driveway).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds on all nine; the gold route changes state frame to frame; the cool rim means assessed on 1 and 4. Faults: hot blue interiors on 5 and 8; the rim device disappears after 4; the filled roofs on 7 not legible.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral carries claim ids; the 7 minutes attributed and conditioned; the absence scoped; drawn to illustrate covers the invented colours and plates.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, how and who adopted are clear; the Texas stake is the absence and the action only 'Watch for the first'.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, S2 pays, S3 to S4 clean; S6 and S7 could swap; S5 and S8 both trained beats; the close's picture is the softest.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: House style clean; kickers have character; deks stay close to the release; the caption's closing question sounds like a person.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Media change across the deck; frames 1 and 9 share one world by design.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 7 around its obstruction with a modelled root plate and crater, a clear curve around the crown tip, and the camera lifted off the dead wet asphalt.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Featureless root plate, empty wet asphalt with an aliased reflection, the route barely bends, filled roofs not legible.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise and push the camera so the oak lies across the middle third, a torn soil disc with roots and crater, curve the route around the crown tip, crop the reflective foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin operator with mitten hands; the pole and wire cut through the headline.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the pole and wire out of the type field and reframe over the shoulder so the map and one pointing hand fill the lower half.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Repeats frame 1's suburb with evenly spread detail; the tower small; the route short.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Street level with the starred tower filling the left half and the route running up the street to its base.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight untapered limb with leaf tufts; a chrome sphere on the roof.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A tapering forked limb with bark and a pale break; the sphere as a turbine vent.
